offers.name: Product Audit
offers.description: Find the friction. Know what to improve first.
offers.note: A review of an existing product. Redesign and implementation are scoped separately.

offers.name: Design Sprint
offers.description: One focused challenge. A tangible way forward.
scope: Up to 4 primary screens or states
offers.note: A focused design engagement. Recruiting and user testing are scoped separately.

offers.name: Product Project
offers.description: Bring a substantial feature from idea to handoff.
offers.note: A defined feature or workflow. The full scope and schedule are confirmed in a proposal.

offers.name: Design Partner
offers.description: A consistent design partner as your product evolves.
offers.note: Meetings count toward capacity. Extra work, rollover, and payment terms are agreed before kickoff.
